import { DockLayout, Button, row, col, tabs } from "march/ui" import { sun, moon, coffee } from "march/icons" // ruh hâli panosu: üç pano; her birinin beğeni sayısı sekmede rozet olur. Sekmeleri sürükleyip panoyu yeniden diz. const Board = (props: { emoji: string; text: string; onLike: () => void }) =>
{props.emoji} {props.text}
export function MoodBoard() { let $sun = 0 let $moon = 0 let $coffee = 0 const panels = [ { id: "sun", title: "Sabah", icon: sun, badge: () => $sun || null, content: () => $sun++} /> }, { id: "coffee", title: "Öğle", icon: coffee, badge: () => $coffee || null, content: () => $coffee++} /> }, { id: "moon", title: "Gece", icon: moon, badge: () => $moon || null, content: () => $moon++} /> }, ] return
}
